SpaceX is now reusing the same rocket boosters over 20 times each
caption:
SpaceX builds rockets that fly themselves back home after launch. Before SpaceX, every rocket that had ever flown was thrown away the moment it was used. Now they land upright on drone ships hundreds of miles out in the ocean, or get caught mid-air by a giant arm on the launch tower.

It sounds impossible. It also works. SpaceX has reused some of the same booster rockets over 20 times each, and every other rocket company in the world is still trying to figure out how they do it.
